name: SKAT
summary: SKAT was a heavy-liquid bubble chamber at the Serpukhov accelerator, measuring neutrino-nucleus interactions and testing electron/muon universality and oscillation signatures.
detection_principle: Neutrino interactions in dense freon-containing liquid produced charged tracks recorded by several cameras. Track geometry, magnetic curvature and electromagnetic conversions distinguished electron, muon and hadronic final states.
